# 158 Camps on the 6:00–7:00 sector — Black Rock City 2026

Camp placements are official Burning Man Project data and may be shown to users from Aug 23 12:01am (the dataset terms lift the camp-location embargo then; this release ships Aug 27). Playa Pal is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or verified by Burning Man Project.

## 2 girls 1 camp

**Where:** 6:00 & D · **From:** San Francisco & NYC · **Landmark:** Neon poop emoji · **Year:** 2026

We're slinging slushies—The No.1 (Yellow) and The No.2 (Brown). Fiber-spiked for flow, booze-spiked for fun. Join us in the Center Camp Oculus for traditional coconut oil wrestling—thumbs welcome, dignity optional, hilarity guaranteed.

*More: https://2girls1camp.com/*

## 42 Ramen

**Where:** D & 6:45 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Light maze labyrinth on the ground (red) · **Year:** 2026

We know the answer to the ultimate question. If you know it, come and tell us to claim your yummy prize.

## 706 Tribe

**Where:** G & 6:15 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** 706 Tribe flag with a dog cartoon · **Year:** 2026

Where scattered stories meet - a diaspora of makers and dreamers, kindred spirits building home in the nowhere. Ink in the wind. Roots in the dust. Home in each other.

*More: https://706tribe.com/en/*

## A Shack of Sit

**Where:** Esplanade & 6:45 · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** truss arch, near giant LED snowflake · **Year:** 2026

Do you feel like belting out a karaoke song or letting out your frustrations in our rage cage (uncaged)? Are you looking for a great spot to sit, grab some cold water, and watch the world go by while getting your nails painted, moisturizing your face, and enjoying a percussive massage? Are you looking for the Mensa Camp? Come visit A Shack of Sit; where sit happens. We will be waiting for you in Snowflake Village.

## Abstininthe

**Where:** D & 6:45 · **From:** Santa Barbara · **Landmark:** Large "Abstininthe" sign, lit at night · **Year:** 2026

The friendly bar on the playa, providing our special drink to the thirsty of BRC since the last millennium. Come try our many flavors and enjoy the music, ambiance and conversation of our neighborhood bar. Now serving non-alcoholic shrubs.

*More: https://www.facebook.com/abstininthe/*

## Acorn Oasis

**Where:** 6:30 & F · **From:** Long Beach, CA · **Landmark:** 9' glowing Orb/Acorn · **Year:** 2026

Are we human or are we squirrel? Come on down to Acorn Oasis to meet like-minded folks, lose your nuts in carnival games, and feast your eyes on some legendary squirrels. We'll keep our nuts warm for you.

## Alma Borekas

**Where:** 6:30 & D · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** Big white tent with colorfull banners. · **Year:** 2026

Moroccan atmosphere with Middle Eastern influence. Traditional chilling area and an open bar serving signature cocktails from 12 PM to 2 PM. Our legendary Borekas will be served on Tuesday, and mint tea will warm you up at night. Our welcoming seating area is for YOU to relax or go partying, depending on the hour.

*More: https://www.almaborekas.com*

## Amulet

**Where:** C & 6:45 · **From:** Castro Valley · **Landmark:** two 15' tall Yellow vertical "Amulet" flags · **Year:** 2026

Whether you seek magic or inspiration, join us at Camp Amulet for a morning pineapple pancake, and find out where and when our next Amulet pop-up will be. At our Amulet table, you'll be gifted a brass dog tag; pre-stamped with the Burning Man symbol. Our highly skilled Amulet Counselors will guide and inspire you to make your mark, and answer the great pressing questions of your life as you customize your Amulet. Using metal stamping tools you can add names, numbers, symbols, astrological signs, and Viking runes. After you have all the answers, we'll put your Amulet on a necklace, keychain or bracelet for you when you're finished.

## Apotheneum

**Where:** D & 6:45 · **From:** New York City · **Landmark:** Large 30-foot translucent dome · **Year:** 2026

Defined as a "place of divine elevation" it is a visual, sonic and haptic instrument intended to "transport" visitors through participatory immersion. Comprised of two nested chambers made of back-to-back LED nets (13,940 nodes in all), Apotheneum presents multiple canvases for collaborating visual artists and an immersive sound system for collaborating sound artists. Measuring 40 x 40 x 40 feet, Apotheneum's cubic antechamber envelops a thirty-foot "inner sanctum" that opens to the sky and is anchored by a 24-foot pressure-sensing "bed" on which visitors are invited to recline, and be transported. At night, evoking aspects of the natural world: wind, fire, lightning, rain, stars, gravity, people and animals, Apotheneum encourages inward contemplation through multi-sensory somatic immersion.

*More: https://www.anthonyfieldman.com/architecture#/apotheneum/*

**Where:** 6:15 & J · **From:** BRC · **Landmark:** Truck Dock · **Year:** 2026

**Where:** Esplanade & 6:15 · **Landmark:** ARTery sign · **Year:** 2026

## Astropups

**Where:** C & 6:45 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Ground level colorful ASTROPUPS sign · **Year:** 2026

Fun, Frisky, and Fabulous! Exploring the Playaverse one Open Heart at a time.

*More: https://www.facebook.com/groups/76339652066*

## B.E.D Bureau of Erotic Discourse

**Where:** E & 6:15 · **From:** Phoenix AZ · **Landmark:** Bright pink and orange lounge with BED flags. · **Year:** 2026

Our camp is dedicated to promoting consent culture at Burning Man by ensuring every theme camp has a BEDucator. We believe in the importance of education and empowerment when it comes to fostering a safe and consensual environment on the playa. Our team of passionate volunteers is committed to providing information and resources to help every camp create a respectful and inclusive space for their participants. Join us in our mission to make Burning Man a place where consent is prioritized and respected by all.

*More: https://bedtalks.org*

## Battle Born Burners

**Where:** G & 6:15 · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** Battle Born Burner Banners · **Year:** 2026

Come play, drink and lounge with us. The only bar on the playa with Nevada-tude!

## Beats 'n Deets

**Where:** 6:30 & B · **From:** Sydney · **Landmark:** Very large (40 foot) furniture van · **Year:** 2026

Don't lose your shit when you lose your shit. Label it first at Beats 'n Deets. We make labels for all your stuff with a mug shot style photo with you and your camp details on it making it easy for people to return it to you or easy to find at lost and found. And it's a great souvenir. Come join us for drinks in our circus tent with animated projections on the wall and some of the most underrated DJ's on the playa. And debuting this year, The Smile High Club. Towering nearly 20 feet above the Playa, soak in the views-or just be a soak.

## Beaverton

**Where:** E & 6:45 · **From:** Oakland, California · **Landmark:** Rainbow Camp Beaverton sign & large Beaver symbol · **Year:** 2026

Camp Beaverton is an intentional, experimental, and experiential Burning Man community theme camp and a legacy sapphic nonprofit organization. Not queer? No fear! We're straight friendly! We are a group of queer women/trans/genderqueer/lesbian/bisexual/heterosexual/etc... or folks who are simply as wayward as the playa is dusty. We celebrate sexuality, self exploration, and respect for one's journey through this life. Our goal is to provide a safe(r), brave(r) space that centers queer women, trans folks, and nonbinary identities on and off-playa. We encourage education, participation, inquiry, conversation, and self-reflection. We extend our goals to the greater Black Rock community by hosting workshops and social events.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/campbeaverton/*

## Bikini Bottom(less)

**Where:** F & 6:45 · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** Big banner with camp name on it · **Year:** 2026

Campy, colorful, and delightfully ridiculous...join some of the best-known sea creatures on the playa. Start your day with morning Tai Chi, then drift over for our daily bottomless mimosas (you and your drink can be bottomless if desired). Feeling athletic? Try the Naked Beer Mile: four beers, one mile, zero clothes, maximum glory. In the afternoons we transform into an Under the Sea Prom, complete with spiked punch, karaoke, campy accessories, and a photo setup so you can capture the most wonderfully absurd prom pictures for your scrapbook. Sequins, scales, fins, pearls, and questionable life choices encouraged.

## Birthday Camp

**Where:** C & 6:15 · **From:** Boulder · **Landmark:** giant birthday cake · **Year:** 2026

At Birthday Camp, every day is a reason to celebrate. Throughout the week we host playful birthday-themed experiences for anyone passing by...wish-making, card writing, surprise celebrations, and spontaneous moments of joy. Whether it's your actual birthday or you just want to feel seen and celebrated, our camp is a welcoming place to stop, connect, and share a little happiness. Because on the playa, everyone deserves a birthday.

## Black Karma

**Where:** D & 6:15 · **From:** Miami · **Landmark:** Black Karma Lights · **Year:** 2026

Black Karma is a lantern lit gathering space built around hospitality, participation, and meaningful connection. In the intensity of Black Rock City, we offer a place to pause, sit, and engage. Each morning we invite neighbors and wanderers to reset, share stories from the night before, and set intentions for the day ahead. Coffee is gifted freely and conversation is encouraged.

*More: https://blackkarma.camp/*

## Black Rock Public Library

**Where:** D & 6:15 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Black Rock Public Library banner on our frontage. · **Year:** 2026

We're a library. Come browse our dusty stacks! One year book checkouts!

*More: https://blackrockpubliclibrary.org*

## Black Rock Sauna Society

**Where:** 6:00 G Plaza @ 9:45 · **From:** Helsinki · **Landmark:** big sauna sign on top of a container. · **Year:** 2026

Experience the essence of Finnish sauna culture amidst the Playa's embrace. Our camp offers invigorating sauna sessions, traditional löyly rituals, and the chance to encounter real life sauna elves! Join us for communal relaxation, deep connection, and the transcendent warmth of the Northern spirit.

*More: https://eldis.fi/black-rock-sauna-society/*

## BLD

**Where:** 6:00 G Plaza @ 2:15 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** 16' observation tower astide shipping container · **Year:** 2026

Swiss Space cow racing, coffee, drinks, and an observation tower for looking out across BRC.

## Booboos Gaagoos

**Where:** D & 6:45 · **From:** Seattle · **Landmark:** Zebra flags · **Year:** 2026

Step right up to the Inaugural Officially Certified Peer-Reviewed Burning Man Awards, the most rigorous celebration of playa excellence in the known universe. Our panel of wildly unqualified judges reviews your finest achievements, from heroic dust storm survival to best abandoned bike rescue, and awards genuine medals of entirely dubious authority. Pull up a seat, plead your case, and claim the recognition you legally deserve.

## Brainiac Camp

**Where:** F & 6:15 · **From:** Bend, OR · **Landmark:** Naked Heart sign on the corner · **Year:** 2026

Brainiac Camp and the Burning Man Philosophical Center: Where Principles Collide and Confusion Is a Feature Welcome to the resurrected Philosophical Center...not a department, not a brand, but a sandbox of inquiry and absurdity. Here, we do what philosophy does best: take your Burning Man-related discomfort, ambiguity, and unresolved contradictions... and roll around in them with delight. Have a conundrum? A dilemma? A principle-on-principle conflict (say, Radical Self-Expression vs. Civic Responsibility)? Bring it.

## Breakaway Republic

**Where:** Esplanade & 6:15 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Lady Mannequin with purple shirt with lights. · **Year:** 2026

Tiny Arms Tavern welcomes all dinosaurs for libations and roar-ing laughter. Open every day, look for the giant T-Rex. Espresso martinis and wine from 9-12 every day!

## Burner Buddies

**Where:** B & 6:45 · **From:** Palm Springs · **Landmark:** Metal towers with a disco ball · **Year:** 2026

We are a relaxed LGBTQI+ camp known for Genital Printmaking based on a traditional Japanese technique, plus throwing some fabulous cocktail parties.

*More: https://www.facebook.com/groups/burnerbuddies*

## Burner Express Bus Depot

**Where:** 6:00 & I · **From:** Black Rock City · **Landmark:** DPW shade structures and the BxB office container · **Year:** 2026

Burner Express Bus Depot for arriving and departing Burner Express buses.

*More: http://burnerexpress.burningman.org*

## Burning Man Studios

**Where:** B & 6:45 · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** Burning Man Studios Polaroid Photo Frame out front · **Year:** 2026

Burning Man Studios is a diverse group of crazies from across the country and across space and time that love movies, bad writing, and self-expression in all its forms. Come by for a drink, some shade, or just to tell us a story. Bar is open every day and random shenanigans all day long.

*More: http://www.burningmanstudios.com*

## Burning Man T-Shirt Factory

**Where:** B & 6:45 · **From:** San Jose · **Landmark:** Buddha Mannequin wearing a BM T-shirt · **Year:** 2026

Interactive DIY BM logo designs. We supply the spray paint and BM logo stencils. You supply the clothing, gear, or body to create your own personalized BM swag. Totally interactive, quick, easy, and fun. Open 24/7.

## Camp Bean Water

**Where:** C & 6:15 · **From:** Cincinnati · **Landmark:** "Camp Bean Water" large painted sign. · **Year:** 2026

Beans, flicking, roasting, steamy dripping love, room for cream ? our secret steps to the finest cup of coffee. Bring your brewtiful self over to Camp Bean Water to enjoy a cup and let us show you the full potential of a coffee shop. All cups of coffee our baristas serve-up are made to order and come with positive affirmations. Looking for something to fill your now stimulated colon, our cooks can fry you up mouth-watering arepas. Love and good vibes are abundant in our cafe, so drip on in. We're open every weekday morning. We have special evening events like arepa night and a special sunrise opening.

*More: https://campbeanwater.com*

## Camp DIY

**Where:** G & 6:15 · **From:** Silver City, NM · **Landmark:** "Camp DIY" signs, overhead, lighted at night. · **Year:** 2026

Camp DIY offers daily Agua Fresca (non-alcoholic) refreshments Monday to Friday of Burn Week. We also have crafty supplies for you to "Pimp Your Cup".

*More: https://www.facebook.com/campdiyburningman/*

## Camp Elephant Toe

**Where:** 6:30 & G · **From:** Denver · **Landmark:** Lilac, purple, blue, azure and green flags · **Year:** 2026

Like camel toe only bigger. We are the mutant vehicle support camp for Alladin's Lamp, a bottom of the genie bottle experience making playa dreams come true since 2023. Stop by for some music and drinks (21+).

## Camp Just Ahead

**Where:** 6:00 & E · **From:** Beaumont, TX · **Landmark:** monkey hut and the big spinning wheel · **Year:** 2026

Come spin our big WHEEL OF INDETERMINATE IMMEDIACY to choose a short, fun activity to do with us! These activities create will human connection, encourage radical self-expression, and send you away with a smile. Some are silly playa games, others could be mildly naughty, and others are thoughtful conversation-starters. All can be adapted as needed for age, ability, etc. We will also (with consent) gift some photos of the fun too, delivered in a private online gallery afterward. Activities will be updated through the day and across the week, so come by more than once! Afternoons Mon-Fri, see our site for details!

*More: https://campjustahead.art*

## Camp Orange Heart

**Where:** 6:00 & E · **From:** Aspen · **Landmark:** Orange Heart Flags/Banner · **Year:** 2026

Our camp is founded on the principles of unconditional love, mutual respect, honesty, trust, and transparency. Our goal is to provide a deeper intimacy among all human beings with respect to the eight types of intimacy and a mocktail bar for burners. No drama type of camp - only love, respect, and radical acceptance!

## Camp PlayApology

**Where:** 6:30 & F · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** "PlayApology" Banners + Lit 24-Hr Apology Dropbox · **Year:** 2026

You eff up, we fix it! Black Rock City's first "Custom Apology Delivery Service" offers Playa-friendly flowers, Burner-centric cards & singing "SorryGrams" for BRC residents looking to make playAmends. We also have cards for other occasions. Grab a Sorry Spritz, peruse our catalog and make someone's day cards that say everything from "I'm So Sorry" to "You're Awesome!" and "Happy Burn Mitzvah!"

*More: https://playapology.com/*

## Camp Pull My Finger

**Where:** E & 6:45 · **From:** Somers · **Landmark:** neon "Camp Pull My Finger" sign · **Year:** 2026

Come join us for Biscuits and Gravy Tuesday and Thursday morning. "Best Thing You Will Put In Your Mouth all week" (Maybe second). Themed afternoon bars all week

## Camp Scone Fucker

**Where:** 6:00 & E · **From:** Reno and Denver mainly · **Landmark:** Checkerboard scone oven · **Year:** 2026

Come get Sconed with us. 9 unique flavors to try throughout the week and ice cold tea to wash it down. All while grooving to our camp DJs R & B, House, Rock, and Lo-Fi beats. Come chill out in the shade with a glass of ice tea or partake in our playground. Maybe we will have a fun surprise or two.. or three?

*More: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61555334052330*

## Camp Seem to Leave

**Where:** D & 6:15 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** colorful geodesic hammocks out front. · **Year:** 2026

Your sticky home away from home. We humbly welcome you, and the dusty pile of tetanus you rode in on. Drop by for a life-changing cocktail & leave with a side quest.

## Camp TeaPunk

**Where:** 6:30 & E · **From:** Goodrich · **Landmark:** big sign and bell tent · **Year:** 2026

Stop by our Steampunk inspired tea/coffee/cocktail tent and chill for a bit. With victorian furniture, plush rugs, a cuddle puddle, small library and games you're sure to feel welcome as you prop your feet up and relax. Looking for something more upbeat? Our "Teabag Olympics" might be for you. With relay races in high heals, granny panty competitions and other hilarious happenings, you're sure to find fun and laughter, all while listening to an array of DJ beats. Our campers are the family you wish you had, we welcome you to stop in and say hi!

*More: https://campteapunk.com/*

## Camp VRC

**Where:** F & 6:15 · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** Yellow Short School Bus and Camp VRC sign · **Year:** 2026

Camp VRC is about capturing and sharing the Burning Man experience beyond the playa by means of immersive 360 D virtual reality (VR) footage. Lose yourself in past year's VR experiences or jump in and help us build a global network to carry the impact beyond the playa. Monday to Saturday, 3-5pm, at the yellow short schoolbus. Also, you might find us POP-UP, to show footage, at other busy events throughout the playa.

## CAMP WWIT

**Where:** 6:30 & C · **From:** New York · **Landmark:** Frontage saying Wait, What's in This and neon sign · **Year:** 2026

CAMPWWIT is place to ask yourself the question, "Wait, What's In This?" We explore the playa experience through snarky reflection, encouraging internal monologue and external dialogue through games, drinks, and music. With everything going on during the burn, we hope you can reflect on what's going on inside you with others to help bring these playa lessons out into the default world!

*More: https://www.instagram.com/campwwit/*

## Captain Pump's Raiders

**Where:** F & 6:15 · **From:** Boulder, CO · **Landmark:** Captain Pump's Raiders Sign · **Year:** 2026

Black Rock City's finest giant-robot driving mercenary company, and we roll a mean D20. Come visit us for RaiderCon XI, the Playa's premier (and possibly only) roleplaying-game convention! Don't miss our Starcraft and Magic tournaments.

*More: https://www.facebook.com/pumpsraiders/*

## Census

**Where:** Esplanade & 6:30 · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** Pink Census signs/flags and colorful data displays · **Year:** 2026

The Census has been collecting information about the population of Black Rock City since 2002. The results of the Census from previous years will be on display at the Census Lab on playa and published in the Population Analysis Report at https://blackrockcitycensus.org

*More: https://census.burningman.org*

## Chariot Project

**Where:** 6:30 & A · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** Yellow flags w/ gold Chariot Project sign · **Year:** 2026

Injured? Have a footsie-oopsie-daisy? Fear not! Our pedal-powered mobility carts are available for checkout by the day and attach to your own bike. We also offer canes, crutches, orthopedic boots, knee braces, and more to support your journey - whether you're healing up, rocking senior power, or living with a disability. There's a transport option for you.

*More: https://burningchariots.com/*

## Children of Chaos

**Where:** C & 6:45 · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** 2 8' "Children of Chaos" orange flags frame camp · **Year:** 2026

Children of Chaos, established in 2000, is returning to the playa! Join our Gold Parade, have your fortune told, stop by our conversation bar and have a drink and a chat! Our campers hail from Reno, Portland, Seattle, San Francisco, Denver, and Houston.

*More: https://chaoscamp.wordpress.com/*

## Cinematic Regrets

**Where:** E & 6:15 · **From:** San Diego · **Landmark:** Large hanging camp name sign in LED. · **Year:** 2026

Step into an immersive, fully enclosed space-themed cinema where the playa disappears and the cosmos begins. After sunset, we screen iconic sci-fi films paired with thoughtfully curated popcorn and cocktails inspired by each film. Come dressed for the galaxy or barrow from our costume closet to ear your ticket and join the experience.

## Clevian Circularity

**Where:** Esplanade & 6:45 · **From:** Milwaukee · **Landmark:** 11' diameter glowing Snowflake · **Year:** 2026

Dates back to 30,000 BC. We channel a mystic lost civilization. Are you a Clevian too?

## Cockpit

**Where:** B & 6:45 · **From:** New York City · **Landmark:** Giant tipi tent · **Year:** 2026

We will spirit burners away to the golden age of air travel where they can stop by, relax and recuperate in our airport lounge with an espresso or green juice by day, or a cocktail by night, before taking flight again back to the playa.

## Cold Yogis

**Where:** E & 6:15 · **From:** Santa Cruz · **Landmark:** We have a huge lit up COLD YOGIS sign at the front · **Year:** 2026

Cold Yogis exist to awaken terrestrial spirit, creative life force and ancestral resiliency by wilfully disrupting the status quo and immersing into the true self! We offer workshops for breathwork, cold exposures, brain over body techniques, verbal liberation, yoga and tantra to increase health, self awareness, and consciousness. We host playa's most epic Ecstatic Dances. We are an international camp that shares space with Naked Heart and others.

*More: http://www.coldyogis.org/*

## Cosplay Central

**Where:** F & 6:15 · **From:** Irvine · **Landmark:** Life-size Barbie and Ken dance boxes in the front · **Year:** 2026

The most awesome Cosplay/Larping experience on earth! Come and play in our Barbie/Ken and Burner girl boxes - you will dance like crazy. Come by and get involved in some fun activities in the Cosplay world - we have costumes and props. AND For sexy and adventurous couples- We have a Barbie theme and naturally Ken being a dickless doll will be fitted with a male chastity cage and Barbie will hold the key!!!

## Counter Culture

**Where:** C & 6:45 · **From:** Richmond, California · **Landmark:** black and pink Counter Culture and Census banners · **Year:** 2026

We are the BRC Census support camp. Drop by anytime to learn about what Census does and the information we have to share.

## Crepiphany

**Where:** 6:00 & C · **From:** Seattle · **Landmark:** Big colored "Crepiphany" sign and café tables · **Year:** 2026

The Crepiphany café offers a typical Parisian-style experience with chef-cooked crêpes and puzzles.

## Davey Jones Locker Pirate Cove

**Where:** E & 6:45 · **From:** Las vegas · **Landmark:** Large pirate ship with mast · **Year:** 2026

The Davey Jones Locker is docked in pirates cove this year! Come climb aboard the top of the ship via the fishy climbing net off the side! Sing some sea shanties with us, relax in the shade on the roof deck or enjoy some weird wacky and wonderful music, which half comes from boxes of records! Come come pick some music and play!

## Dilated Peoples

**Where:** C & 6:45 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** white (illuminated) DILATED PEOPLES lettering · **Year:** 2026

The Eye Spa at Dilated Peoples Dust in your eyes? Step into the sanctuary of Dilated Peoples for a total sensory reset. Surrender to a choreographed journey designed to expand your inner vision. Sink into a reclining chair as we indulge your senses with chilled cucumbers, cooling gel masks, and the restorative scent of weighted lavender. Our camp family anchors the experience with caring touch and an immersive soundscape to help you truly let go. Offering tranquility and sensory restoration Monday?Wednesday afternoons.

*More: https://www.facebook.com/dilatedpeeps/*

## Dr. Carl's Collection of Depts.

**Where:** 6:00 Portal · **From:** Portland · **Landmark:** Walls of tiles, oval sign. Lit up pink and blue. · **Year:** 2026

Dr. Carl's Collection of Departments returns! Come play our legendary Dept. of Collections game, where we will give you a semi-fabulous prize if you can do, are, or tell us about a thing we list on the board of tiles. Enjoy a homebrew at our Dept. of Dumpster Dive Bar. Learn and play Go in our Dept. of Strategy, enjoy our blacklight Hissing Booth, or let fate decide at our luscious pink Kiss-Met randomizer.

*More: https://www.drcarlscamp.com/*

## Dr. Playa's ENT Clinic

**Where:** Esplanade & 6:15 · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** Metal Dr Playa's ENT Clinic sign · **Year:** 2026

Dr Playa's ENT Clinic helps Black Rock Citizens clean out their head holes daily. Open 12PM-3PM. Since 1792

*More: https://drplayas.com*

## Dreamery

**Where:** 6:00 G Plaza @ 3:45 · **From:** Laguna Niguel, CA · **Landmark:** DREAMERY roadsign, Star tent, Deep Thought Art Car · **Year:** 2026

Dreamery is a camp to discover, share and experience dreams. It is an interactive space to read and write dreams and fantasies, happy or scary, random and crazy, sensual or sad. What dream would you ask for if you could? If you could go anywhere in a dream, where would it be? At Dreamery, you might also meet someone special. You can see if you want to hang out for just a bit or maybe become lifelong soulmates. Got any bad dreams you want to get rid of? Drop them to the Dreamery Alter to be ceremonially burned at The Temple Burn. Have any happy dreams or exciting tales to tell? Jot them down in The Book of Dreams. Flip through the pages to discover stories and dreams from people from around the world, and you might even find new dreams to call your own.

## Drink and Drive-In

**Where:** 6:00 & F · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** Big blue lockers with a lady body on top. · **Year:** 2026

At our camp we condone drinking and driving-in to enjoy a movie and a drink with us! We have chairs, and games, and whit. If you've got nothing else to do, and you've had a few too many, PULL UP.

## Duckbutt

**Where:** B & 6:45 · **From:** Las Vegas · **Landmark:** Bright green DUCKBUTT sign · **Year:** 2026

Waddle on over and quack yourself up with our ri-duck-ulous games.

## Enrichment.Institute

**Where:** F & 6:15 · **From:** Los Angeles / Torrance · **Landmark:** Companion Cubes · **Year:** 2026

The Aperture Science Enrichment Center ("Portal") has joined forces with The Institute ("Fallout") to form the Enrichment.Institute The Enrichment.Institute reminds you that the Weighted Companion Cube will never threaten to stab you and, in fact, cannot speak. However, any advice it does give you should be radically included. The Weighted Companion Cubes are from the computer game "Portal"; this year there will be two, one companion cube and one steampunk cube. They are single rider, mutant vehicles, mobile art pieces, a 3 foot square cube, with sound and lights. Remember, the cake is a lie! The Portal Enrichment.institute hosts the Weighted Companion Cube Mutant Vehicles. The entire camp is Synth Free. No radiation! Home of the Apocaloptimist, the Agnostic Pope, but you can't prove it.

*More: https://enrichment.institute*

## Fantastic Sams

**Where:** E & 6:45 · **From:** Denver · **Landmark:** Big Fantastic Sams sign, and the big wedding tent · **Year:** 2026

Camp Fantastic Sams serves breakfast in the morning, debauchery in the afternoon, and drinks in the evening. We are a LGBT+ camp, and we have a comfy "cuddle puddle" for after dark (and during the daytime).

## Felis Mundi

**Where:** Esplanade & 6:00 Portal · **Year:** 2026

## Fire Conclave Convergence

**Where:** Esplanade & 6:00 Portal · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** Fire Conclave sign and photo gallery · **Year:** 2026

Fire Conclave Convergence is where Fire Performers, Ambient Drummers, and Documentarians who will be performing in the Great Circle will be signing in and receiving procedural information. Those with a Black Rock passport can also get their passport stamped.
